summary.name: AltTab
summary.one_liner: AltTab is a free, open-source macOS window switcher that brings Windows-style Alt-Tab to the Mac, showing every individual window with previews, with an optional Pro tier adding search, more styles and extra shortcuts.
use_cases: switch between windows of the same app on a Mac
find a specific window by typing part of its title
preview windows before switching to them
locate minimized or hidden windows across Spaces
replace the default Cmd-Tab app switcher
summary.what_it_does: AltTab lists every window, including those within the same app, minimized, hidden, or on another Space, and labels where each one is. The selected window is shown at full size above other windows so the user can confirm it before switching. Users can switch between thumbnails, app icons, or a compact list of titles, though the styles option is part of Pro. Pro also adds search by window title or app name, auto-size, and additional shortcuts. The source code is on GitHub under GPL-3.0 and can be built independently.
notable: Open source under GPL-3.0 with source on GitHub
Shows minimized, hidden and other-Space windows with location badges
Full-size preview of the selected window before switching
caveats: Search, extra styles, auto-size and additional shortcuts require AltTab Pro, with a 14-day free trial
The Pro license applies to the pre-built signed binaries, not the source code
